
CREATE-BUG
Create a new bug with research guidance for understanding existing code before fixing

WHEN TO USE
  Use when tracking bugs that require researching existing scenarios, implementation, and test coverage before fixing to prevent regression.

PREREQUISITES
  • Prefix must be registered: fspec create-prefix PREFIX "Description"
  • Epic must exist if using --epic: fspec create-epic EPIC "Title"
  • Parent bug must exist if using --parent

USAGE
  fspec create-bug <prefix> <title> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <prefix> (required)
    Bug prefix (e.g., BUG, FIX, HOTFIX). Must be registered with create-prefix first.
  <title> (required)
    Brief description of the bug

OPTIONS
  -d, --description <description>
    Detailed description of the bug
  -e, --epic <epic>
    Epic ID to associate with this bug
  -p, --parent <parent>
    Parent bug ID for hierarchical relationships

TYPICAL WORKFLOW
  Create bug: fspec create-bug PREFIX "Title",Follow research guidance from system-reminder,Search scenarios: fspec search-scenarios --query="keyword",Search implementation: fspec search-implementation --function="functionName",Check coverage: fspec show-coverage feature-name,Add reproduction steps: fspec add-example BUG-001 "Reproduction steps",Add fix scenarios: fspec add-rule BUG-001 "Expected behavior",Move to specifying: fspec update-work-unit-status BUG-001 specifying

EXAMPLES
  1. Create simple bug with research guidance
  $ fspec create-bug BUG "Login validation broken"
  ✓ Created bug BUG-001
  Title: Login validation broken

<system-reminder>
Bug BUG-001 created successfully.

CRITICAL: Research existing code FIRST before fixing bugs.
  fspec search-scenarios --query="login"
  fspec search-implementation --function="validateLogin"
  fspec show-coverage
</system-reminder>

  2. Create bug with epic
  $ fspec create-bug BUG "Memory leak in dashboard" --epic=performance
  ✓ Created bug BUG-002
  Title: Memory leak in dashboard
  Epic: performance

  3. Create critical bug with description
  $ fspec create-bug HOTFIX "Critical auth bypass" --description="CVE-2024-1234"
  ✓ Created bug HOTFIX-001
  Title: Critical auth bypass
  Description: CVE-2024-1234

COMMON ERRORS
  ✗ Prefix 'PREFIX' is not registered
    Fix: undefined

  ✗ Parent bug 'PARENT-001' does not exist
    Fix: undefined

  ✗ Epic 'epic-name' does not exist
    Fix: undefined

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec fspec search-scenarios - Search existing scenarios by keyword
  fspec fspec search-implementation - Search implementation for function usage
  fspec fspec show-coverage - Check test coverage for features
  fspec fspec list-features - List all feature files
  fspec fspec add-rule - Add expected behavior rule
  fspec fspec add-example - Add reproduction steps
  fspec fspec update-work-unit-status - Move bug through ACDD workflow

NOTES
  • Bugs require research BEFORE fixing to prevent regressions
  • System-reminder guides AI agents to use research commands
  • Bugs should link to existing features when fixing behavior
  • Bugs may or may not require new tests (depends on coverage gaps)
